source_note: Synthetic incident-response playbooks. All actions are SIMULATION ONLY.

items.title: SSH compromise / lateral movement response
items.summary: For brute-force + SSH lateral movement + payload retrieval: collect mock evidence, simulate session revocation, simulate endpoint isolation (requires approval), open case. Confirm evidence before containment.

items.title: Insider misuse response
items.summary: For off-window access to restricted/canary assets by a valid identity: collect mock evidence, simulate session revocation, open case, engage HR/insider-threat process (out of scope for prototype).

items.title: Canary/decoy interaction response
items.summary: Any canary interaction is high signal. Activate additional isolated decoys, collect mock evidence, open case.

items.title: Cross-site campaign correlation
items.summary: Correlate low-severity findings sharing identity/infrastructure across sites into one campaign incident; escalate for coordinated review.
